label: Sci-Fi Attire
description: Non-armor sci-fi costume — street tech, spacer workwear and lit fabrics; the hard-light counterpart to wardrobe/fantasy. Tagged 'scifi' for genre coupling.

items.name: cyberpunk-jacket
items.text: a cropped cyberpunk jacket, electroluminescent piping tracing every seam, high asymmetric collar, holographic decals peeling at the shoulder

items.name: holo-slip-dress
items.text: a slip dress of holographic film, oil-slick color shifting with every movement, laser-cut hem floating weightless

items.name: fiberoptic-gown
items.text: an evening gown woven with fiber-optic strands, constellations of cold light drifting through the midnight fabric

items.name: station-jumpsuit
items.text: a fitted orbital-station jumpsuit, quilted thermal panels at shoulder and knee, magnetic tool tabs, a data cuff blinking at the wrist

items.name: spacer-layers
items.text: layered spacer robes over a pressure-mesh undersuit, dust-sealed goggles pushed up, breather mask hanging at the throat

items.name: vinyl-raincoat
items.text: an asymmetric transparent-vinyl raincoat over graphic thermal layers, glossy plastic catching every light source, cargo straps at the thigh
